items.excerpt: 'As Deep as the Grave' has released seven minutes of footage built around an AI-generated younger Val Kilmer, the late actor's estate-approved posthumous 'performance.' It is the most concrete public look yet at how a digital-replica lead is actually assembled, lit and cut into a narrative film.

James Gray tells IndieWire the industry's 'obscene' AI push will fail and predicts celluloid gets a 'vinyl' style comeback, after shooting 'Paper Tiger' on film with vintage tools. A craft-side counter-argument that frames analog imperfection as the differentiator against generated imagery.

DP Sophie Darlington explains how the patience, imperfections and long-lens waiting behind Nat Geo's 'Lion' are precisely what generative video cannot fake. A working cinematographer's argument for what stays human when AI slop floods the feed.

Red Empire Productions and Organic Media Group are developing 'Alishan Escape,' a hybrid-AI Mandopop ghost musical inspired by Taiwan's Ghost Month. A concrete example of the hybrid pipeline model — live-action performance plus generative sequences — moving into genre features.

Inside the film Academy's annual all-members meeting, leadership laid out how it plans to 'engage' with AI alongside budget and YouTube strategy. Sets the tone for how Oscar-eligibility and craft-branch rules may treat generative tools in the coming awards cycle.

Mirage ran a day-long experiment broadcasting a 24-hour newscast staffed entirely by AI-generated anchors covering real stories. A blunt stress test of what fully synthetic, always-on video production actually looks and feels like at scale.

Honored at Locarno 2026, makeup legend Rick Baker gives his verdict on AI and CGI and makes a case for the below-the-line experts he says go unappreciated. A practical-effects master's read on where machine imagery leaves hand-built craft.

Filmmaker and former Luma AI executive Verena Puhm has launched LA-based Matriarch to produce AI-native and hybrid projects, including work for brands and third parties. A tool-vendor insider crossing over into production is a signal of where AI-native studio craft is heading.

Animation Magazine details Matriarch's slate, which is developing AI-native and hybrid animation productions for its own pipeline and for third-party and brand clients. Adds the animation-craft angle to the new prodco's AI-first workflow claims.

Animaze Montreal's 2026 edition (Sept 17-19) adds a first-ever AI Animation Forum alongside its regular programming. A festival institutionalizing AI as a craft track rather than a controversy panel marks a shift in how the animation field is handling it.

Strada 2.0 mounts a collaborator's storage as a virtual drive so a remote editor can cut from media that never leaves the original disk, on top of the platform's AI tagging and search layer. It targets the real bottleneck in AI-assisted post: moving the footage, not the metadata.

Aputure's amaran Mic is a $99 wireless desktop microphone with a 30mm dynamic capsule and on-board AI noise reduction. On-device AI cleanup is now shipping at entry-level price points for creator audio, not just post suites.

No Film School tests OBSBOT's Meet Flip, a foldable 4K webcam whose AI tracking and framing push webcam image quality closer to usable production gear. A look at how much AI-driven framing can substitute for an operator on small shoots.

Curious Refuge walks through a free AI video generator that they argue has closed much of the quality gap with paid models, with side-by-side shot tests. Aimed squarely at filmmakers deciding where their generative budget should go.

An honest hands-on review of Wan 3.0, the video model Curious Refuge calls the best generator most filmmakers have not tried yet. Covers where it holds up on motion and character consistency in an actual shot workflow.

Curious Refuge runs 30 different characters through Seedance 2.5 to see how far reference-driven character consistency now holds across shots. A practical benchmark of the single hardest requirement for narrative AI filmmaking.
